theVF62DISCREPANCYRESOLVED.whatTHECAPTAINSREADINGACTUALLYMEASURED: the `value` column of production-field-map.json, which is null for ALL 179 fields of this document -- including DefName, the petitioner's own name, which is written on multiple widgets of every delivered fixture. A whole-page added-ink scan of all 43 pages caught it: pages 18, 19, 23, 24, 27, 30, 31, 35, 38, 40 and 43 carry added ink and page 20 carries none. The corrected measurement is the one reported above. This is recorded because a zero taken on the wrong page is exactly the kind of reading that closes a real finding by accident.
